description: 16-week plan for beginners building both running endurance and functional fitness from scratch.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 1 min easy jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 6-7 times. Total 20 min. Focus on finding comfortable jogging pace.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Focus on depth - go as low as comfortable with good form. Keep chest up.

exercises.name: Push-up (modified if needed)
exercises.notes: Can use knees if needed. Full range of motion more important than reps.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: 10 reps per leg. Focus on knee tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.notes: 20-30 seconds per set. Maintain straight line from head to heels.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 1 min easy jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 6-7 times. Same structure as Monday.
Optional: 20-30 min easy walk

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Add 2 reps from Tuesday. Focus on control.

exercises.name: Push-up (modified if needed)
exercises.notes: Same as Tuesday. Consistency over progression this week.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Squeeze glutes at top. Hold for 1-2 seconds.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.notes: 10 reps per side. Slow and controlled movement.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 1 min easy jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 8 times. Slightly longer than weekday sessions.
Alternate: 1.5 min jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 6 times. Increasing run intervals.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Progressing reps. Maintain form over speed.

exercises.name: Push-up (progress from knees if ready)
exercises.notes: Try 2-3 full push-ups if modified last week, then switch to knees.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: 12 reps per leg. Step back rather than forward.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.notes: Increase to 30 seconds. Rest 30-45 sec between sets.

exercises.name: Burpee (modified)
exercises.notes: Step back to plank, step forward, stand. No jump yet.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 1.5 min jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 6 times.
Optional: 20-30 min easy walk or light stretching

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: 12 reps per leg. Alternate legs each rep.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: 12 reps per side. Lower back stays pressed to floor.

exercises.name: Burpee (modified)
exercises.notes: Add 1 rep. Still stepping, not jumping.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 1.5 min jog, 1.5 min walk. Repeat 8-9 times. Equal work/rest.
Alternate: 2 min jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 6 times. Run intervals now equal to walk intervals.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Increasing volume. Can add 1-2 second pause at bottom.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.notes: Progress to more full push-ups, fewer modified.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: 10 reps per leg. Back foot elevated on bench/chair.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.notes: Add jump at top if ready, otherwise continue stepping.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 2 min jog, 2 min walk. Repeat 6 times.
Optional: 30 min easy walk

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Introducing light weight (10-15 lbs). Hold at chest.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: 20 seconds per side. Can drop to knees if needed.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 2.5 min jog, 1.5 min walk. Repeat 7-8 times. More running than walking now.
Alternate: 3 min jog, 1 min walk. Repeat 5 times. Reduced volume for recovery.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Same weight as last week, reduced volume.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 3 min jog, 1 min walk. Repeat 5 times.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Back to bodyweight for recovery week.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 4 min jog, 1 min walk. Repeat 5 times. Recovery week - keep it easy.
Try 5 min continuous jog, 1 min walk, 5 min jog, 1 min walk, 5 min jog. Building to continuous running.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Increase weight from week 3. Focus on depth.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: 12 reps per leg. Can add light dumbbells if ready.

exercises.name: Plank to Downward Dog
exercises.notes: Start in plank, push hips up to downward dog, return. 10 reps.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.notes: Full burpees with jump. Focus on consistent pace.

days.cardioNotes: Alternate: 5 min jog, 1 min walk. Repeat 4 times.
Optional: 30 min walk or light yoga

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: 12 reps per arm. Support on bench.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: 15 reps per leg. Can hold light dumbbells.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.notes: 20 total reps (10 per leg). Controlled pace.

days.cardioNotes: Try 10 min continuous jog, 1 min walk, 10 min jog, 1 min walk, 8 min jog. Building endurance.
Try 20 min continuous jog, 5 min walk cooldown. Milestone week!

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Increase weight, reduce reps. Building strength.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Introducing RDL. Focus on hip hinge, hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Tap
exercises.notes: 20 total taps (10 per side). Minimize hip rotation.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing (light)
exercises.notes: Introducing kettlebell work. Hip hinge movement.

days.cardioNotes: 20-25 min continuous easy jog. No walking unless needed.
Optional: 30 min walk

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press or Push-up
exercises.notes: DB bench if available, otherwise weighted push-ups.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.notes: 12 reps per leg. Can hold dumbbells.

days.cardioNotes: 30-35 min continuous run. First true long run. Keep pace easy and conversational.
25-30 min continuous run at comfortable pace.

exercises.name: Push-up with Rotation
exercises.notes: Push-up, rotate torso and extend arm to ceiling. 10 per side.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge with Dumbbells
exercises.notes: 12 reps per leg. Preparing for sandbag lunges.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.notes: 12 reps per side. Anti-rotation core work.

days.cardioNotes: Easy 25 min run. Recovery pace.
Optional: 30 min walk or mobility work

exercises.name: Front Squat or Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Progress to front squat if comfortable with form.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: 15 reps per arm. Rowing strength for ergwork.

exercises.name: Plank Pull-through
exercises.notes: In plank, drag weight side to side. 10 per side.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Introducing HYROX-specific movement. Burpee + horizontal jump forward.

days.cardioNotes: 35-40 min continuous run. Building aerobic base for HYROX 8K.
Easy 25 min run. Recovery week - reduced volume.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Reduce weight and volume for recovery.

days.cardioNotes: Short easy 20 min run.
30 min easy run. Recovery week - keep it conversational.
30 min steady run. Back to building after recovery week.

exercises.name: SkiErg Intervals
exercises.equipmentNeeded: SkiErg. If no SkiErg: rowing machine (same distance/time) or assault bike (2x time)
exercises.notes: 4 x 200m with 90 sec rest. Learn technique, don't rush.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine Intervals
exercises.notes: 3 x 500m with 2 min rest. Focus on proper stroke: legs, hips, arms.

days.cardioNotes: Easy 25 min recovery run.
Optional: 30 min walk

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.notes: Heavier weight, building leg strength for sleds.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Posterior chain work for sled pulls.

days.cardioNotes: 40 min steady run. Continuing aerobic development.

weeks.weekFocus: Integration - Wall Balls and Burpee Broad Jumps

days.cardioNotes: 35 min steady run.

days.dayName: HYROX Stations - Wall Balls and Burpees

exercises.name: Wall Ball Shots
exercises.equipmentNeeded: wall ball 14-20 lbs (men) or 10-14 lbs (women). If no wall ball target: thrusters with dumbbell
exercises.notes: 4 x 15 reps. Squat depth, explosive throw to 9-10 ft target.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
exercises.notes: 4 x 10 reps. Full burpee, then jump forward as far as possible.

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.notes: 3 x 250m, rest 90 sec. Building erg capacity.

days.cardioNotes: Easy 25 min recovery run.
Optional: 30 min walk or yoga

exercises.name: Push-up with Shoulder Tap
exercises.notes: 12 taps per side while in plank.

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.notes: 10 rows per arm from plank position.

days.cardioNotes: 45 min long run. Building toward 8K race distance endurance.
10 min warm-up, 15 min at comfortably hard pace, 5 min cooldown.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.equipmentNeeded: sled with light weight 50-70 lbs. If no sled: prowler, heavy farmers carry 50m, or resistance band sprints
exercises.notes: 4 x 25m pushes. Learn technique before adding weight. Low position, drive with legs.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.equipmentNeeded: sled with rope 50-70 lbs. If no sled pull: heavy rope pulls 25m or bent over rows 3x15
exercises.notes: 4 x 25m pulls. Hand over hand technique. Stay low.

days.cardioNotes: Easy 30 min recovery run.
Optional: 30-40 min walk

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Building push strength for wall balls.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: 12 per arm. Pull strength for sleds and rows.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.equipmentNeeded: heavy dumbbells or kettlebells 40-50 lbs per hand
exercises.notes: 3 x 50m carries. Introducing farmers carry work.

days.cardioNotes: 50 min long run. Peak long run volume for base phase.

weeks.weekFocus: Integration - Farmers Carry and Sandbag Lunges

days.cardioNotes: 10 min warm-up, 6 x 1min hard / 2min easy, 5 min cooldown. Building speed.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.equipmentNeeded: heavy kettlebells or dumbbells 50-70 lbs per hand. Use heaviest available.
exercises.notes: 4 x 50m carries. Challenge your grip and posture.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunges
exercises.equipmentNeeded: sandbag 40-60 lbs. If no sandbag: goblet lunges with heavy dumbbell 40-50 lbs
exercises.notes: 4 x 25m (50m total). Bag on shoulders, alternate leg lunges.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.notes: 3 x 20 reps. Building wall ball endurance.

days.cardioNotes: Easy 30 min recovery run.
Complete circuit: one set of each station with minimal rest between. Rest 5-10 min, repeat. Total 2 rounds.
50 min long run. You can now run 8K distance comfortably.
10 min warm-up, 20 min tempo at comfortably hard pace, 5 min cooldown.
First brick workout. Learning to run after stations. Total ~3km running + 2 stations.
Easy 25 min recovery run after brick workout.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.notes: 3 x 1000m with 3 min rest. Building rowing endurance.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.notes: 4 x 25 reps. Rest 2 min between sets.

days.cardioNotes: 55 min long run. Peak weekly run volume.
10 min warm-up, 8 x 1km @ race pace with 90sec rest, 5 min cooldown.
Multi-station brick. Total 5km running + 4 stations. Learning race transitions.
Easy 25 min recovery.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.equipmentNeeded: race weight KBs (64kg total for men, 48kg for women)
exercises.notes: 4 x 100m at race weight. Building capacity.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.notes: 3 x 30 reps, building to 100 rep capacity.

days.cardioNotes: 60 min long run. Can complete full 8K+ distance now.
Easy 30 min run. Staying fresh for race sim.
Full rest before race simulation.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.equipmentNeeded: sled at race weight (102kg men/78kg women) or slightly lighter

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.equipmentNeeded: sled at race weight or slightly lighter

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Full 80 reps. Break as needed but minimize rest.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 2x32kg KB (men) or 2x24kg KB (women) or 80-90% race weight

exercises.name: 1km Run
exercises.notes: Final 1km - give it everything you have left

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.notes: Final station - 100 reps. This will hurt. Break as needed.

days.cardioNotes: FULL HYROX RACE SIMULATION (scaled). 8km running + all 8 stations. Weight can be 80-90% of race weight. Focus on pacing, transitions, and finishing. This is your dress rehearsal. Note finish time and how you felt at each station.
Full rest after race sim. Light stretching or walking only.
Very easy 20 min shake-out run. Recovery pace only.
Rest. Reflect on race simulation. Note areas to improve.
20 min easy run, then 4 x 20sec strides at race pace. Keep legs sharp.

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.notes: 2 x 200m easy. Just touching the movement.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.notes: 2 x 10 reps. Keep movement pattern fresh.

days.cardioNotes: Light work only. Not trying to improve, just maintaining feel.
20 min very easy run. Just moving.
Complete rest 2-3 days before race.
10 min easy jog, 3 x 15sec strides. Day before race. Keep it short and easy.

RACE DAY! You've done the work. Trust your training. Execute your race plan: Start conservative on 1st km. Find your rhythm on stations 1-3. Dig deep on stations 4-6. Leave it all out there on stations 7-8. You've got this!
